df2_renamed = df2.rename(columns={

    'county': 'county_y'
})

# --- Step 4: Prepare df3 ---
# df3 columns: ['state', 'fips_code', 'ansi_code', 'county_name', 'population', 'housing_units', 'area_land_mt', 'area_water_mt', 'area_land_mi', 'area_water_mi', 'latitude', 'logitude']
# Rename 'state' to 'state_y' (to match df2 and distinguish from df0)
# Rename 'county_name' to 'county_name_y'
df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={
    'state': 'state_y',
    'county_name': 'county_name_y'
})

# --- Step 5: Prepare df4 ---
# df4 columns: ['state', 'fips_code', 'county', 'diabetes_count', 'diabetes%']
# Rename 'state' to 'state_y'
# Rename 'county' to 'county_x' (target has both county_x and county_y, diabetes_count and diabetes% are related to county_x in target)
df4_renamed = df4.rename(columns={

})

# --- Step 6: Prepare df5 ---

# --- Step 7: Merge all dataframes step by step on 'fips_code' ---
# Start with df0_renamed as base

df_01 = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1, on='fips_code', how='left')

df_013 = pd.merge(df_01, df3_renamed, on='fips_code', how='left', suffixes=('', '_df3'))

# Merge df4_renamed (diabetes info) on fips_code
df_01324 = pd.merge(df_0132, df4_renamed[['fips_code', 'state_y', 'county_x', 'diabetes_count', 'diabetes%']], on='fips_code', how='left', suffixes=('', '_df4'))

# Merge df5 (drug_deaths) on fips_code

df_final['county_x'] = df_final['county_x'].combine_first(df_final['county_name_x'])

# Ensure correct dtypes for integer columns (fill NaNs with 0 or appropriate)
int_cols = ['statefp', 'countyfp', 'fips_code', 'Civilian_labor_force_2012', 'Employed_2012', 'Unemployed_2012',
            'ansi_code', 'population', 'housing_units', 'area_land_mt', 'area_water_mt', 'naics', 'unions_count',

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/training_5.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source3 on fips_code
result = pd.merge(source0, source3, how='inner', left_on='fips_code', right_on='fips_code', suffixes=('_x', '_y'))

# Join with Source1 on fips_code
result = pd.merge(result, source1, how='inner', left_on='fips_code', right_on='fips_code')

# Join with Source4 on fips_code
result = pd.merge(result, source4, how='inner', left_on='fips_code', right_on='fips_code', suffixes=('', '_y'))

# Join with Source2 on fips_code
result = pd.merge(result, source2, how='inner', left_on='fips_code', right_on='fips_code', suffixes=('', '_z'))

# Join with Source5 on fips_code
result = pd.merge(result, source5, how='inner', left_on='fips_code', right_on='fips_code')

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
# From source0: state_x, statefp, countyfp, county_name_x, fips_code, winning_party, State, Area_name, Civilian_labor_force_2012, Employed_2012, Unemployed_2012, Unemployment_rate_2012
result.rename(columns={
    'state_x': 'state_x',
    'statefp': 'statefp',
    'countyfp': 'countyfp',
    'county_name_x': 'county_name_x',
    'fips_code': 'fips_code',
    'winning_party': 'winning_party',
    'State': 'State',
    'Area_name': 'Area_name',
    'Civilian_labor_force_2012': 'Civilian_labor_force_2012',
    'Employed_2012': 'Employed_2012',
    'Unemployed_2012': 'Unemployed_2012',
    'Unemployment_rate_2012': 'Unemployment_rate_2012',
    # From source3: state_y, ansi_code, county_name_y, population, housing_units, area_land_mt, area_water_mt, area_land_mi, area_water_mi, latitude, logitude
    'state_y': 'state_y',
    'ansi_code': 'ansi_code',
    'county_name_y': 'county_name_y',
    'population': 'population',
    'housing_units': 'housing_units',
    'area_land_mt': 'area_land_mt',
    'area_water_mt': 'area_water_mt',
    'area_land_mi': 'area_land_mi',
    'area_water_mi': 'area_water_mi',
    'latitude': 'latitude',
    'logitude': 'logitude',
    # From source1: naics, unions_count
    'naics': 'naics',
    'unions_count': 'unions_count',
    # From source4: county_x, diabetes_count, diabetes%
    'county': 'county_x',
    'diabetes_count': 'diabetes_count',
    'diabetes%': 'diabetes%',
    # From source2: county_y, inactivity_count, inactivity%
    'county_y': 'county_y',
    'inactivity_count': 'inactivity_count',
    'inactivity%': 'inactivity%',
    # From source5: county_name, drug_deaths
    'county_name': 'county_name',
    'drug_deaths': 'drug_deaths'
}, inplace=True)

# Some columns may have suffixes due to merges, fix those:
# For source4 and source2, county columns may have suffixes, fix them:
if 'county_y_y' in result.columns:
    result.rename(columns={'county_y_y': 'county_y'}, inplace=True)
if 'county_x_x' in result.columns:
    result.rename(columns={'county_x_x': 'county_x'}, inplace=True)
if 'county_name_x_x' in result.columns:
    result.rename(columns={'county_name_x_x': 'county_name_x'}, inplace=True)
if 'county_name_y_y' in result.columns:
    result.rename(columns={'county_name_y_y': 'county_name_y'}, inplace=True)

# Group by the leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema:
group_by_cols = ['state_x', 'statefp', 'countyfp', 'county_name_x', 'fips_code', 'winning_party', 'State', 'Area_name']

# Aggregations: sum for numeric columns except group by columns
agg_dict = {
    'Civilian_labor_force_2012': 'sum',
    'Employed_2012': 'sum',
    'Unemployed_2012': 'sum',
    'Unemployment_rate_2012': 'sum',
    'state_y': 'first',  # string, but from join, keep first
    'ansi_code': 'sum',
    'county_name_y': 'first',  # string, keep first
    'population': 'sum',
    'housing_units': 'sum',
    'area_land_mt': 'sum',
    'area_water_mt': 'sum',
    'area_land_mi': 'sum',
    'area_water_mi': 'sum',
    'latitude': 'sum',
    'logitude': 'sum',
    'naics': 'sum',
    'unions_count': 'sum',
    'county_x': 'first',  # string, keep first
    'diabetes_count': 'sum',
    'diabetes%': 'sum',
    'county_y': 'first',  # string, keep first
    'inactivity_count': 'sum',
    'inactivity%': 'sum',
    'county_name': 'first',  # string, keep first
    'drug_deaths': 'sum'
}

# Some columns may be missing due to suffixes or merge, filter agg_dict keys accordingly
agg_dict = {k: v for k, v in agg_dict.items() if k in result.columns}

# Perform groupby and aggregation
result = result.groupby(group_by_cols, dropna=False, as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Write to CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_73/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
